Context: the job-search pipeline lives in /Users/prab/Downloads/claud jobs. applications.csv is the dedupe source of truth (10 columns: date,company,role,ats,url,status,confirmation_text,salary_stated,cover_letter_attached,notes). loop/dedupe.py checks it by company name.

Today (2026-09-11) I applied to MAU / AI-LAB's "AI Full Stack Developer" role (Teamtailor, https://leadtech.teamtailor.com/jobs/8083644-ai-full-stack-developer). The task named the company "MAU", so `python3 loop/dedupe.py --check "MAU" ...` and `grep -i "MAU" applications.csv` both came back clean. The real ATS organisation is "Leadtech" (leadtech.teamtailor.com, emails from leadtech.teamtailor-mail.com) - MAU/AI-LAB is just a product brand within Leadtech.

While completing an email-verification step for that application I searched Gmail (account prabhavitg@gmail.com) and found two rejection emails from Leadtech, both for a DIFFERENT requisition, "AI Automation Engineer":
- Thread 19fa76fc4d0251ea, 2026-07-28, subject "Thank you for your time - Leadtech" (rejection, following an application received 2026-07-27, thread 19fa50d744a8384e)
- Thread 19fefeaa6dd9d8fb, 2026-08-11, subject "Thank you for your time - Leadtech" (rejection, following an application received 2026-08-10, thread 19feb976e69c559e, plus a "Welcome to Leadtech TT" talent-community email same day, thread 19feba5474358917)

Neither of these applications or rejections is logged in applications.csv at all - only unrelated Leadtech rows exist (an ACTION_REQUIRED WTTJ row from 2026-08-06 for "AI Full Stack Developer" that was never completed, two DEAD Workable postings, one DEAD Teamtailor "AI Product Engineer" posting). This is a real gap: the candidate applied to and got rejected from Leadtech twice in the last 6 weeks, and the dedupe system has no record of it.

Please:
1. Add two SUBMITTED-then-REJECTED-style rows to applications.csv for these two "AI Automation Engineer" applications/rejections (best-guess ATS/URL from context if not otherwise discoverable - check Gmail threads above for any application-received email that might name the original posting URL or ATS), so the historical record is complete.
2. Check loop/dedupe.py and/or wherever company names get resolved for a place to record that "MAU" and "AI-LAB" are brand names for the Leadtech Teamtailor org, so a future `--check "MAU" ...` call also searches "Leadtech" (or vice versa). A simple alias map or a note in a relevant README/RULES file may be the lightest fix - use judgment on how the existing dedupe tooling is structured before adding new machinery.
3. Do not touch today's already-submitted MAU/AI-LAB "AI Full Stack Developer" application (applications.csv row dated 2026-09-11, company Leadtech, status SUBMITTED) - that one already went through and should stay as is.
Reading dedupe tooling + CSV structure first, then Gmail threads for the original posting URL.
Fixing the two new rows so the ATS field has no commas, then final verification.

Done. Two backfilled Leadtech rows logged, brand alias fix live in dedupe, row for the Sep 11 application untouched.

**1. applications.csv** ([applications.csv:3974](Downloads/claud%20jobs/applications.csv:3974), [applications.csv:3975](Downloads/claud%20jobs/applications.csv:3975))
- 2026-07-27 Leadtech, AI Automation Engineer, ATS "Workable (best guess)", URL apply.workable.com/j/5C848DC811, status REJECTED. Notes carry the Gmail thread ids (application 19fa50d744a8384e, rejection 19fa76fc4d0251ea).
- 2026-08-10 Leadtech, AI Automation Engineer, ATS "Teamtailor (best guess)", URL leadtech.teamtailor.com/jobs, status REJECTED. Thread ids 19feb976e69c559e, 19fefeaa6dd9d8fb, 19feba5474358917 in notes.
- ATS/URL are best guesses and flagged as such in the row. Evidence: LinkedIn job 4443779109 (Leadtech Group, posted Jul 22) mirrors to Workable job 5C848DC811 via freehire; the "Welcome to Leadtech TT" email on Aug 10 reads as a Teamtailor Connect welcome. The Gmail connector is not attached to this session, so the original emails could not be re-read. Salary and cover-letter fields say "unknown (backfilled row)".
- Row 3907 (Sep 11 MAU application) is byte-identical to before. Note it is already REJECTED as of Sep 15, not SUBMITTED.
- Backup at applications.csv.bak-0916. The file is being written by another live session (a Coltech row landed mid-edit); that row was preserved.

**2. dedupe alias** ([loop/dedupe.py:29](Downloads/claud%20jobs/loop/dedupe.py:29))
- Added `ALIASES` dict inside `norm_co`: mau, ai-lab, "mau / ai-lab", "mau ai-lab" resolve to leadtech. Applies to both corpus build and `--check`, and to sweep.py which imports `is_seen`.

```

AI-LAB    HIT COMPANY
Leadtech  HIT COMPANY
```

- Lesson appended to [loop/RULES.md](Downloads/claud%20jobs/loop/RULES.md) (dated 2026-09-16): when the queue company differs from the ATS domain or email sender org, check both names and add the pair to ALIASES.
